summary: Section 57 verified end-to-end. Backend GET /api/banners/banner-of-the-week (no auth) returns María's Cleaning Services pinned festive banner with 13 likes (highest). Landing page renders <BannerOfTheWeekCard /> with all required testids. Mobile BottomNav (logged in) has exactly the new 5-item order: Home, Search, Community, Gigs, Account; bottom-nav-messages is gone. Community uses HeartHandshake (lucide-heart-handshake) icon. Tap heartbeat animation: icon receives 'tapping' class on click and clears within ~550-700ms. ComunidadLayout TabBar and ComunidadPage internal nav both show HeartHandshake svg (2 found). comunidad-feed renders. comunidad-pull-indicator/new-posts-banner are conditionally rendered (absent on initial load as expected). Regression checks /galeria-banners and /banner-gallery both return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: ComunidadPage.jsx is 870+ lines — consider splitting PostFeed, internal nav, and tab logic into separate files for maintainability.
BannerOfTheWeekCard fetches from /banners/banner-of-the-week via `api.get` (axios) on mount; consider caching at the SWR/react-query layer to avoid re-fetch on every Landing visit.
401 console errors observed on public Landing page (likely from unauthenticated /me or /conversations probes). Not blocking but adds noise — gate those calls on user presence.

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded 5 demo banners.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Section 57 is fully verified. BottomNav is gated by `useAuth().user` — to test the mobile bottom nav you MUST be logged in. For SVG class checks, use el.getAttribute('class') (not el.className, which returns SVGAnimatedString and serializes to '{}'). The 60s polling and 2-min visibility refresh in PostFeed were not exercised live as instructed; code paths exist.
